meaning: Sputnik activation vertical floor = 100 (hex 64). The plane flies at or above this cabinet height; spawnSputnik seeds pos.v = VPLMIN. EQU.

A killed Sputnik scores 4× the ICBM value. SPUTKI loads X=3 and jumps to the shared multiple-score routine (GEKILL), which awards X+1 = 4 units — the line's own comment reads '(4X ICBM)'. Derived as the LDX I,3 immediate + 1, mirroring MC-MIRV-MAX's inclusive-loop derivation.

source.verbatim: LDX I,3			;SUB. GIVE MULTIPLE SCORE (4X ICBM)

meaning: Per-activation Sputnik launch-count cap = 4. The launch-count clamp compares the computed headroom against 4 and saturates ('MAX AT 4'), so a plane never fires more than 4 ICBMs at once. Immediate operand of CPX/LDX I,4.
Sputnik ICBM fire-cadence table, frames between launches, indexed table-SPUTWV and clamped to the last row past wave 8. Hex bytes 80,60,40,30,20,20,10 decode to 128,96,64,48,32,32,16.

Sputnik activation-separation table, frames between plane activations, indexed table-SPUTWV and clamped to the last row past wave 8. Hex bytes 0F0,0A0,080,80,60,40,20 decode to 240,160,128,128,96,64,32.
